description: Use when someone wants to list, write or settle a prediction market on a Tickerz index. A market on the index's next print, ready to paste, for LAYOFFS, MINTS, GIGS, WAGE: question (one sentence, with {strike} left to fill from strikes), period (the next UTC day, or the week ending the Saturday named, that has not begun), strikes (the 10th, 30th, 50th, 70th and 90th percentiles of the last 30 published numbers, two significant digits, equal ones listed once, null under 14 prints), settle_time_utc (when that period's number is expected to be published; null for the weekly index, where settle_rule gives the window), settle_rule (the number as first published, in column settlement_value of the settlement file; a later revision never changes it), tie_rule (a print equal to the strike resolves No), fallback, precision, grade and rulebook from the index's rulebook, source_url, settlement_file (CSV), mirror_file (the same file on a public mirror), proof (the daily OpenTimestamps proof), recount (the commands that recount a print from the chain; null where none exists), next_print_at, license, and paste: the whole market as plain text under 600 characters. Any other index returns no_kit with the reason. Same data as GET /api/indices/{ticker}/listing.json. Showing a number is free; settling real money on it is licensed: https://tickerz.com/pricing. Not advice.
